title: One manual round of the harness self-improvement loop (S6c)
hypothesis: A three-sentence addition to the opening instructions (state the suspected cause, edit by the budget midpoint, run the narrowest check before finish) raises acceptance on held-in and held-out tasks without changing any other surface.

prerequisites.text: Card 007 complete, and E3-calibration-007.sets.json lists held_in (up to 8 tasks whose trajectories produced the evidence) and held_out (8 other evolution-set tasks never inspected while writing the candidate)
S6b signatures have chosen the target cluster
Candidate wording fixed in the markdown card before any run
S6a wiring for the mutation task file (see card 007)
owner approval (then set status to approved)

arms.name: candidate

runner.unresolved: run_pilot.py has no flag for the opening instructions; S6c must add a bundle declaration (a runner flag whose value enters the protocol hash) or point this arm at a candidate worktree's run_pilot.py that differs only in INSTRUCTIONS

text.unresolved: exact wording, at most three sentences, fixed in the markdown card before any run

arms.note: Nothing else in the bundle changes; its protocol hash must differ from the incumbent's only through the instructions.

arms.name: no-change
arms.note: The incumbent run twice more on 4 tasks to estimate evaluation noise; identical protocol to incumbent.

noise.note: The markdown does not say which 4 tasks; this card draws them by seed from the 16 paired tasks.

campaign.note: 64 paired runs + 8 no-change runs = 72 x 24 attempts = 1,728 planned, plus room for 11 retried runs. About two hours of wall time at 90 s per run; no monetary cost.

stop_rules.repeat_rule: No repeat stop in any arm (identical predeclared rule across arms, plan 5.3 for E4).
manual: Stop if the candidate changes any surface other than the opening instructions (bundle hash check).
Stop if the held-out list is read by anyone writing the candidate.

decision_rule: Promote only if delta_in >= 0 and delta_oh >= 0 and max(delta_in, delta_oh) exceeds the no-change arm's observed spread. Otherwise reject and log. A rejected candidate with delta_oh < 0 is also evidence for S6's diff-review gate: record what the edit encoded.
notes: delta:candidate:incumbent is reported per task set, so the held_in row is delta_in and the held_out row is delta_oh; delta:no-change:incumbent on the noise set is the spread.
Plan now: blocked on the task-set file, the candidate runner, and the candidate wording, each named by --plan.
